question: Which district has the largest 2011 population, and what is the exact difference between Patna and Gaya?

view.title: 2011 District Population – Patna, Gaya, Nalanda
view.note: Each bar shows the total population recorded in the 2011 Census for one district. The tallest bar is the largest district. The exact difference between Patna and Gaya is stated in the insight above the chart.

interpretation_guard.caveat: This chart shows population size only. It does not explain why one district is larger than another.
